text: Writing tests is a vital part of software development. Unit tests check small pieces of code, like a single function, to make sure they work correctly in isolation. Integration tests, on the other hand, verify that different parts of a system work together smoothly. Many developers use test-driven development, where you write a failing test first, then write the code to make it pass. This approach helps catch bugs early. Ultimately, a good testing strategy gives you confidence. You can change or improve your code, and the tests will quickly tell you if you’ve broken something, allowing you to ship more reliable software.
